adjudication_summary: Source-reviewed re-review resolved the blocking worker-2, worker-4, and worker-6 ticket for thanatin in DOI 10.1038/s41467-019-11503-3. The paper is publication-grade with cautions: local MOESM supplement files are absent/represented only by HTML landing pages, but the recorded AMP activity, DBAASP row adjudication, toxicity context, and mechanism claims are all supported by primary XML/PDF evidence.

caution_findings.finding: The local supplementary_original assets are duplicated Nature HTML landing pages, not the XML-referenced MOESM PDF/XLSX files. Owner-layer activity/database/mechanism values used for final curation are supported by primary XML/PDF text, so this is not an unresolved gate-relevant missing value.

Supplementary Tables 1-4 and Source Data are referenced by the article but not available as local PDF/XLSX assets. No final activity/database value was fabricated from those absent files; exact figure series remain non-digitized.
The rework ticket requested Tables 1/2/3, but the primary XML exposes two table-wraps. Table 1 and Table 2 were re-reviewed; no primary XML Table 3 exists.

The local database packet has zero linked_sequence_records. Sequence/name/modification identity for Thanatin was verified from primary XML synthesis/introduction text, while DBAASP assay rows were matched to primary-source activity/FIC locators.

The Source Data XLSX named in the article is not present locally. Final mechanism claims rely on primary XML text and figure captions; exact plotted numeric series were not converted into standalone activity records.

materials_exhausted.note: Owner-layer repair reopened packet manifest, locator index, raw XML/PDF, extracted PDF text, figure captions, supplementary index/original assets, packet database JSONL, and final/work artifacts. Local supplementary assets are HTML landing pages, so absent MOESM files were treated as nonblocking cautions because primary XML/PDF supports the final recorded values.

per_layer_decision_rationale.layer_3_mechanism: Worker-6 adjudicated direct mechanisms from primary XML result sections and figure captions without promoting absent Source Data numeric series into unsupported exact values.
